title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not part of the 1976 divided-power De Rham notes. It is a typescript page ('- 134 -', exposé 'IX') of Grothendieck's SGA 7 I, Exposé IX, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie', §11.3, filed in this folder. The typescript has an unfilled cross-reference blank '(I      )'. The handwritten '2', '452' and '141' are archive or folio numbers.

Setting.
- A_K and A'_K are dual abelian varieties over the fraction field K of a henselian DVR.
- U = T_ℓ(A_K) and U' = T_ℓ(A'_K) are their ℓ-adic Tate modules, with ℓ different from the residue characteristic.
- (11.3.2) is the Weil pairing U ⊗ U' → Z_ℓ(1).
- I is the inertia group. (11.3.3) is the standard tame structure 1 → R → I → T → 1, where R is pro-finite of order prime to ℓ (the wild inertia together with the prime-to-ℓ tame part) and T is the pro-ℓ quotient, isomorphic to Z_ℓ(1).

Goal. Define Φ = (U⊗D_ℓ)^I / (U^I⊗D_ℓ), with D_ℓ = Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ, and the analogous Φ'. These are the ℓ-primary parts of the component groups of the Néron models. The aim is to build a perfect duality Φ ⊗ Φ' → Q/Z (11.3.5), which gives the pairing announced in (11.3.1). That pairing is Grothendieck's pairing between component groups, defined via monodromy.

Method.
- Take the exact sequence 0 → U → U⊗Q_ℓ → U⊗D_ℓ → 0 and its long exact sequence in continuous cohomology of I.
- Since U^I is saturated in U, the image of j^0 is U^I⊗Q_ℓ / U^I = U^I⊗D_ℓ. So Φ = coker j^0.
- By exactness, Φ ≅ Ker(i^1).
- Because H^1(I, U⊗Q_ℓ) = H^1(I,U)⊗Q, Ker(i^1) is the torsion subgroup of H^1(I,U). This gives (11.3.8): 0 → Φ → H^1(I,U) → H^1(I,U)⊗Q.

On the published continuation (from memory, not seen on this page): the next step uses R being prime to ℓ to reduce to H^1(T, U^R). That group is computed as the coinvariants of U^R under a topological generator of T. The torsion of these coinvariants is then paired with Φ' via cup product, Weil pairing and the duality for T.

ideas.what: Identification of the ℓ-part of the Néron component group with (U⊗Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ)^I / (U^I⊗Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ), equivalently with the torsion of H^1(I, T_ℓ A)
ideas.modern_name: ℓ-primary component group via Galois cohomology of inertia
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck, SGA 7 I Exp. IX (1967-69, publ. 1972)

ideas.what: Perfect duality Φ ⊗ Φ' → Q/Z on ℓ-parts (ℓ ≠ p), induced by the Weil pairing and the tame inertia structure
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck, SGA 7 IX (the general conjecture was later treated by McCallum, Bégueri, Bertapelle, Bosch and others)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typescript page of the published SGA 7 Exp. IX (p. 134), apparently misfiled in the divided-power De Rham folder. Its content is fully published and well known. The only point of note is archival: the typescript (with an unfilled reference blank) sits in this cote.
